About For Honor:
Step into the battlefield to experience the chaos and glory found only in For Honor. 

Whether battling through a gripping campaign or clashing with others in intense multiplayer modes and PvP modes, players choose from history’s deadliest warriors, each from a fierce rival faction — the bold Knights, the brutal Vikings, the deadly Samurai, the fearsome Wu Lin, and the enigmatic Outlanders. 

For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience that continues to evolve with major gameplay updates, new Heroes, thrilling events, and more, keeping the conflict alive and ever challenging.

text:
Rayman Legends Retold - Kung-Foot EVO Tournament Highlights
10 teams, 10 regions. Who will become the first-ever Kung Foot EVO champions? Creators from around the world gathered to defend their nation's colors and battle for the title 🏆

The fan-favorite mode is back! With improved ball controls, game-changing power-ups, and customizable rules, Kung Foot EVO takes the chaos, competition, and fun to a whole new level. Step back onto the pitch when Rayman Legends Retold launches October 1.

Pre-order available now: raymanlegendsretold.com 

About Rayman Legends Retold:
Embark on a bold reimagining of the critically acclaimed platformer, enhanced with stunning 3D visuals and an immersive new story leading to a mysterious new realm. Play the adventure solo or in up to four‑player couch co‑op, jam through all‑new musical stages, saddle up for epic dragon rides, and more!
